concerns.text: Task T006 (Mixed‑effects modeling & collinearity diagnostics) is placed **after** T005, but `statistical_analysis.py` (implemented in T005) imports and calls `mixed_effects.py`. The consumer (T005) is scheduled before its producer (T006), violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule.

Task T011 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but writes to a shared `data/results/resource_usage.csv` without any indication of concurrency control. Running multiple pipeline scripts in parallel could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
